# Diana Wallace

Diana Wallace is a poet. Three books, named below.

## The Poet Who Forgot Her Name

- Canonical page: https://dianawallace.org/books/the-poet-who-forgot-her-name
- Full title: The Poet Who Forgot Her Name: Poems for the Returning Self
- Author: Diana Wallace
- ISBN-13: 9798241723536
- Book I of three
- Format: paperback poetry collection
- Pages: 216
- Published: 2025
- Reader response stated on the site: 5.0 from 8 Amazon reviews; #1 New Release in Women's Poetry
- Purchase: https://www.amazon.com/Poet-Who-Forgot-Her-Name/dp/B0GDVZ1WMC
- Qualification: the book is literature, not medical advice or a replacement for professional mental-health care
- Trauma-healing poetry guide: https://dianawallace.org/guides/poetry-for-healing-after-trauma
- Finding-yourself-again guide: https://dianawallace.org/guides/poems-about-finding-yourself-again

## The Girl Who Grew Fangs

- Canonical page: https://dianawallace.org/books/the-girl-who-grew-fangs
- Full title: The Girl Who Grew Fangs: A Book of Remembering After the Fall Into Shadow
- Author: Diana Wallace
- ISBN-13: 9798994577424
- Book II of three
- Poems: 53
- Pages: 175
- Published: February 17, 2026
- Paperback $16.99 · eBook $9.99
- Purchase: https://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B0GP1N2ZCF
